note: Product-neutral fixtures for registries/operating-model/instruction-source-registry.schema.json and scripts/lib/instruction-source-registry.mjs. Every `valid` registry must pass evaluateInstructionSourceRegistry with no problem; every `invalid` registry must produce at least one. No product literals, no absolute machine paths, no dependency on a separate Instance. Digest values are placeholders that satisfy the SHA-256 shape. Temporal model: recorded_state is the held snapshot; divergence.previous_state is the pre-check snapshot (historical); divergence.current_state is the fresh observation and must agree with recorded_state.

valid.note: empty registry — registering nothing is legal
ordinary discoverable source — a repository AGENTS.md, meridian-observed channel, unchanged divergence (previous == current == recorded)
agent-native auto-read source — a CLAUDE.md the agent's own tool loads; changed divergence, recorded_state updated to the fresh observation, so currency is current
external-service source — an organisation wiki page, manual channel, unverified state with divergence unknown
source reported missing — a verified last-known snapshot recorded as stale, status source-missing, no current_state
fresh registration — a verified current_state, no previous_state to compare against, so divergence unknown is the honest status while currency is current
unverified observation — the fresh read could not be verified, and recorded_state.revision_verified matches (both false); status unknown, currency unverified

invalid.note: unknown scope — a scope type outside the six-scope model
unstable identity — an id that is not a stable semantic identifier
unstable identity — no human-readable title
absolute path — the location leaves any declared medium
escape from the scope — a location path that climbs out through ..
file source without container_ref — the opaque medium identity is missing
an opaque container reference that is really an absolute machine path
wrong digest — not a SHA-256
no revision — the recorded state carries no explicit edition
unknown format
unknown read channel
false match without evidence — status unchanged with no previous or current state
false match without proof — status unchanged with an unverified current state
status changed while the two verified states are identical
different revision, same digest, declared unchanged
different digest, same revision, declared unchanged
unknown declared with two complete verified states
recorded_state contradicts divergence.current_state — they describe one present observation
source-missing carrying a current_state
currency current together with a source-missing observation
currency stale without positive evidence the source has gone
unverified revision declared current
unknown format is separate from channel — unknown here is the format axis; declaring the source an accepted norm
declaring the source a norm — record_type norm
undeclared fallback behaviour — the location does not declare what happens when the source is unresolvable
hidden fallback resolution — a missing_behavior other than fail-closed
an agent-native auto-read source that also claims full Meridian control
an agent-native channel that is not marked auto-read
medium and location disagree — an external-service medium carrying a file path
file source carrying resource_ref — the two location forms are mutually exclusive
file source carrying service_ref — the two location forms are mutually exclusive
external-service source carrying container_ref — the two location forms are mutually exclusive
external-service source carrying a path — the two location forms are mutually exclusive
mismatched verification of one present observation — recorded_state.revision_verified true, current_state.verified false
mismatched verification, the other way — recorded_state.revision_verified false, current_state.verified true
source-missing with a previous_state whose revision and digest contradict the held recorded_state
